errorView.title: Something is burning...
errorView.description: An unexpected error has knocked out this post. Don’t worry – your shifts and data are safely packed in the rucksack.
errorView.subtitle: Camp kitchen & tech
errorView.stirLabel: Boiling pot: click to stir the soup
errorView.masterChef: Master chef of the camp kitchen!
errorView.stir0: One good stir! Maybe it works now?
errorView.stir1: Another pinch of Maggi... the secret ingredient of every camp!
errorView.stir2: The soup keeps bubbling. The server takes a deep breath...
errorView.stir3: Careful, hot pot! Don’t burn your fingers.
errorView.stir4: The bottom hasn’t burnt yet – we’re feeling good!
errorView.stir5: The kitchen team nods approvingly. Now try «Reload» again!
errorView.stir6: Full heat reached! Time for a feast!
errorView.wisdom0: If the pot burns: don’t scrape the bottom, add more Maggi and claim it’s part of the secret recipe.
errorView.wisdom1: Camp kitchen rule #2: hunger is the best cook, but a working server doesn’t hurt either.
errorView.wisdom2: Scout tip: when the system crashes, take a deep breath, straighten your scarf and boldly press «Try again».
errorView.wisdom3: Whoever holds the ladle picks the music – unless the server boils over.
errorView.wisdom4: True scouts never lose their cool – they just take a short campfire break.
errorView.wisdom5: Even the best scouting party trips over a root in the code now and then.
errorView.wisdom6: A chocolate banana fixes almost everything. Failing that, reloading the page helps too.
errorView.backLabel: Go back to the previous page

notFound.title: Lost the path in the thicket?
notFound.description: There’s a cosy fire burning here, but no shifts or pages at this fork in the path. Maybe the link is outdated or the post has been taken down.
notFound.subtitle: Camp & shifts
notFound.fireTitle: Click the fire to add wood!
notFound.reaction0: Lovely and warm! But the link you were looking for has gone up in smoke.
notFound.reaction1: The campfire bread is nearly done – grab a seat by the fire!
notFound.reaction2: «The smoke always finds the best-looking one!» – That must be you.
notFound.reaction3: Watch out for sparks! Good thing all the tents are at a safe distance.
notFound.reaction4: The camp leader shouts: «Who threw the shift plan into the fire?!»
notFound.reaction5: Sparks fly up to the North Star... the path you’re looking for is still lost.
notFound.reaction7: Max level reached! Time for marshmallows and chocolate bananas by the fire.
notFound.wisdom0: «The smoke always finds the best-looking one!» – Undisputed law of camp nature since 1855.
notFound.wisdom1: If you get lost in the woods: straighten your scarf, eat chocolate and wait for someone with a torch.
notFound.wisdom2: Rule #1 at the village fair: no shift plan survives the first Saturday-night rush unscathed.
notFound.wisdom3: The compass always points north – unless you hold your pocket knife next to it.
notFound.wisdom4: When in doubt, always follow the smell of freshly grilled sausages or crêpes.
notFound.wisdom5: True scouts don’t get lost – they just explore uncharted side paths.
notFound.wisdom6: The knot holds rock-solid. Nobody knows exactly which knot it is, but it holds.
notFound.wisdom7: The songbook has over 200 songs. Around the campfire we still always sing the same three.
notFound.wisdom8: Whoever is late for their shift has to straighten the bent tent pegs when packing up.
notFound.wisdom9: There’s no bad weather for helpers – only rain capes that are too thin.
notFound.wisdom10: Tip from the camp leaders: always follow the red chalk marks on the trees.
notFound.wisdom11: The best shift is the one that ends with free cake and hot tea.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.infoPassword: When you sign in with your password, we ask for the code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.infoPasswordAndProvider: When you sign in with your password, we ask for the code from your authenticator app, and also when you sign in via {provider}.
twoFactor.infoProvider: When you sign in via {provider}, we also ask for the code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.infoProviderOff: When you sign in via {provider}, we also ask for the code from your authenticator app (currently turned off).
twoFactor.infoSetup: Protect your account with an extra code from an authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Aegis, 2FAS, 1Password or Bitwarden).
twoFactor.notConfigured: Two-factor authentication is not set up on this server yet.
twoFactor.askOnProvider: Also ask for the code when signing in via {provider}
twoFactor.askOnProviderHintPassword: Otherwise the code only applies to your password. Ideally, turn on two-factor authentication directly in {provider} too.
twoFactor.askOnProviderHintNoPassword: Without this setting, the code only protects a later emergency password.
twoFactor.step1: Open your authenticator app and add a new account.
twoFactor.step2: Scan the QR code or type in the key.
twoFactor.step3: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
twoFactor.openInApp: Open in the app on this device
twoFactor.providerHintPassword: Otherwise only when signing in with a password.
twoFactor.providerHintNoPassword: Without a password, this is the sign-in the code protects.
twoFactor.codesWarning: Store these codes somewhere safe, e.g. as a note in your password manager (Google, Apple, 1Password, Bitwarden …) or printed. They let you into your account if you lose your phone. Each code works once. We only show them now.
twoFactor.confirmDisable: To turn it off, we need a current code. After that, your password alone is enough again.
twoFactor.confirmRecovery: Your current recovery codes will stop working. Confirm with a current code.
twoFactor.confirmProviderOn: Also ask for the code when signing in via {provider} from now on. Confirm with a current code.
twoFactor.confirmProviderOff: Stop asking for the code when signing in via {provider}. Confirm with a current code.
